edges: Godfrey has grown to love Phina.
Godfrey is accompanied by his mentor Tartlet on a sea voyage.
Godfrey is marooned on a deserted island after abandoning the ship Dream.
Godfrey rescues Carefinotu from Polynesians visiting the island.
Godfrey is rescued and returned to San Francisco.
Godfrey is reunited with Phina in San Francisco.
